title: Concept: vcpkg manifest with no version constraints
description: vcpkg.json declares a manifest that accepts whatever version the baseline resolves, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a manifest that accepts whatever version the baseline resolves.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through vcpkg.json (vcpkg).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a manifest that accepts whatever version the baseline resolves.
